plain: Chris Bledsoe is a man who says he attracts UFOs and is visited by a being he calls the Lady, who gives him dates and symbols. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says some officials imply that those dates and symbols line up with things they already monitor and have seen from other trusted sources. If so, it would mean Bledsoe's experiences match what the government is tracking on its own.
